title: Aguadilla analyzed in a 200-page SCU document

tellings.quote: they did like a 200page document on it a bunch of different experts people with PhDs.

plain: A 2013 sighting at Aguadilla, Puerto Rico, is said to have been studied in a report of about 200 pages by the Scientific Coalition for UAP Studies, a group of researchers who study unexplained objects in the sky. Michels brings it up himself, in a debate with a skeptic, saying it was written by "a bunch of different experts, people with PhDs." He tells it to show that the case was examined seriously by trained people.
